title: How to use Apple Pay worldwide with your Grey card
summary: Learn how to use your Grey virtual card with Apple Pay for seamless, reliable payments around the world.
body_markdown:

If you’ve ever struggled with cards that randomly fail abroad or get blocked on international platforms, you’ll feel the difference immediately. We built the Grey virtual card built for global use, and Apple Pay simply amplifies that experience.


Let's discuss why the Grey card + Apple Pay combination works so seamlessly.


### One card that adapts to your life


Your Grey virtual card is directly linked to your balance. There’s no need to top up before paying or shuffle funds between wallets. You choose what you want to buy, Apple Pay handles the tap, and the payment goes through.


### Designed for international spending


Fewer card declines. Better compatibility with global merchants. Clearer transactions. Whether you’re paying locally or online, Apple Pay with Grey is consistent and predictable, at home and abroad


### Contactless, effortless, and global


Apple Pay is accepted in millions of locations worldwide. From supermarkets and cafés to trains, taxis, and co-working spaces, your phone becomes your payment tool. Combined with Grey’s global card functionality, spending across countries becomes second nature.


### Built-in security that travels with you


Apple Pay never shares your full card details with merchants, and the Grey virtual card supports 3D Secure for online transactions. Together, they offer a safer way to shop, subscribe, and spend internationally without constant worry.
